title: ElementRegistryView
description: Manifest of custom elements a pillar exposes for cross-pillar embedding. Source of truth: content table with contentFormat='element-registry-manifest' (Category C, operational projection — no new DHT entry type; consistency comes from the underlying Content entry's existing notarization).

eprId.description: EPR id of the registry itself (e.g. 'elohim-core-elements').

tagName.description: Custom-element tag name (e.g. 'elohim-button', 'qahal-attestation-chip'). Must be a valid custom element name: lowercase, contains a hyphen.

cid.description: Content address of the element bundle.

viewDeps.description: ts-rs view type names this element consumes as props.
